data.title: JSCCIB, World Bank unveil roadmap to boost Thailand’s global competitiveness
data.description: BANGKOK, THAILAND – September 3, 2026 —Today, the Joint Standing Committee on Commerce, Industry, and Banking (JSCCIB),comprising the Thai Bankers' Association, the Board of Trade of Thailand, and the Federation of Thai Industries,in partnership with the World Bank, Ministry of Finance, National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC), and Bank of Thailand, convened ‘The Bangkok Business Summit 2026: Reinvent Thailand, Resilient ASEAN’ at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center.

data.title: Porsche Thailand presents Haus of Porsche:
data.description: Porsche Thailand invites Cayenne owners and Porsche fans to experience Haus of Porsche: Cayenne Edition from Sept 5 to 9 at Das Haus BKK, bringing the community together to discover more about the sporty SUV through its heritage and evolution, driving performance, versatility and lifestyle. A key highlight on Sept 5 will be the first and largest gathering of Cayenne drivers in Southeast Asia, alongside the first unveiling of the Cayenne Coupé Electric in Thailand. From Sept 6 to 9, the experience opens up to the public, with curated test-drive experiences and a range of activities that showcase the Porsche ownership experience extending beyond the drive, while creating a space for the Cayenne community to connect, share their passion and create memories together.

data.title: Gallothai: Three Decades of Chocolate Craftsmanship
data.description: Since 1993 , Gallothai has been one of Thailand's leading chocolate manufacturers, blending Belgian craftsmanship with the character of Thai ingredients and terroir.The company holds certifications including ISO 22000 and SMETA at its Chachoengsao facility, with offices in Bangkok, Chiang Mai, and Phuket, and has spent the last 33 years handcrafting chocolates and pastries that blend Belgian expertise with locally sourced Thai ingredients.

data.title: Toyota Supports Volunteer Mission for Royal Funeral Preparation
data.description: On August 27, 2026, Mr. Suraphoom Udomwong, Executive Vice President of Toyota Motor Thailand Co., Ltd., handed over 9 Toyota vehicles along with drivers to the Office of the Permanent Secretary, Prime Minister's Office, represented by Mrs. Chuenchiwan Limteerakul, Deputy Permanent Secretary, Prime Minister's Office. This support aims to facilitate transportation for volunteers and officials performing duties in preparing and organizing the Royal Funeral Ceremony for Her Royal Highness Princess Bajrakitiyabha Narendiradevyavati Krom Luang Ratchasarinee Siripatchar Maha Wanrajarat Chida.

data.title: JSCCIB Chairman Sees Low-Carbon Transition as Major Growth Opportunity for Thailand
data.description: The Co-Chairman of the Joint Standing Committee on Commerce, Industry and Banking (JSCCIB) highlighted the low-carbon transition as both an investment opportunity and a new source of national competitiveness. He called for accelerating the “Reinvent Thailand” agenda to connect the public sector, private sector, and financial institutions, turning policy into execution while bringing SMEs into the low-carbon value chain. He also emphasised the role of Bangkok Business Summit 2026 as a platform to showcase Thailand’s economic potential ahead of the IMF–World Bank Group Annual Meetings and its ASEAN leadership in 2028.

data.title: Audemars Piguet unveils its new boutique concept in bangkok
data.description: Swiss HauteHorlogeriemanufacturerAudemars Piguetiscontinuing the international rollout of itsglobal boutique conceptinthe heart ofBangkok,attheCentral Embassymall.An immersive environment with watches at the centre, the new space spans 264 square metres. Drawing inspiration from the landscapes surrounding Audemars Piguet’s home in LeBrassus, the contemporary interior design invites visitors to step into the Manufacture’s heritage and forward-looking approach to fine watchmaking. Unveiled on 15 June, the boutique will be complemented by an interactive pop-up installation from 11-25 August that offers the public an opportunity to discover the Royal Oak Offshore and its distinctive design codes.

data.title: Why MFA Must Become a Security Baseline for Thai Organisations
data.description: The expansion of digital services, cloud environments, and data connectivity between organizations has enabled both public- and private-sector organizations to serve citizens and customers more quickly. At the same time, however, it has created more opportunities for threat actors to impersonate legitimate users and gain unauthorized access to systems, particularly in organizations that still rely primarily on a “username and password.”

data.title: TrueVisions NOW and NTT DOCOMO stream Vivant to Thai viewers days after Japan broadcast
data.description: In an era where the streaming market competition is measured not only by the volume of content but also by the speed of access and an experience that meets audience demands, TrueVisions NOW x NTT DOCOMO are advancing their strategic content partnership between Thailand and Japan through the “Lemino Japanese Collection” on the TrueVisions NOW app. High-quality Japanese series are delivered to Thai audiences within the same week as their Japanese broadcast, complete with Thai subtitles and Thai dubbing. This reinforces a collaborative model that seamlessly connects content, platforms and fan communities. The partnership continues to deliver experiences from the streaming platform to on-site activities at NIPPON HAKU BANGKOK 2026, a grand Japanese festival held from Aug 28-30, 2026, at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center. The highlight is the new season of “VIVANT”, an action-adventure blockbuster series featuring a thrilling, life-staking secret mission, which creates a space for Thai fans to get up close with the actors and creators and experience the story through activities designed specifically for engagement.

data.title: BDMS to Host Annual Academic Conference 2026 on AI-Era Healthcare Innovation
data.description: Bangkok, August 27, 2026 – Bangkok Dusit Medical Services Public Company Limited (BDMS) is reaffirming its commitment to advancing medical and multidisciplinary excellence while promoting ongoing academic collaboration and knowledge exchange. The company will host the BDMS Academic Annual Meeting 2026 under the theme “Innovative Healthcare Across the Lifespan” from Nov 9-13, 2026, at the BDMS Connect Center, Wireless Road, Bangkok. Held in a hybrid format with onsite participation and online access via Zoom, the conference will broaden access to medical knowledge and provide a platform for healthcare professionals, academics, researchers, and interested participants nationwide to exchange ideas and experiences. Registration is open through October 20, 2026.
